faq.q: How much does Law Office of Ben Ezra Eran charge?
faq.a: Law Office of Ben Ezra Eran publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Law Office of Ben Ezra Eran offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Law Office of Ben Ezra Eran publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Law Office of Ben Ezra Eran have offices?
faq.a: Law Office of Ben Ezra Eran publishes one office, in North Miami Beach. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Law Office of Ben Ezra Eran?
faq.a: Law Office of Ben Ezra Eran names two attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Florida does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
